May 18, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Jim Roumell increased its stake in Rubicon Proj Inc (RUBI) by 66.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roumell Asset Management Llc bought 448,535 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.17% with the market. The hedge fund run by Jim Roumell held 1.12M shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.09M, up from 670,565 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roumell Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Rubicon Proj Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $123.83M market cap company. The stock increased 1.22% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $2.49. About 497,871 shares traded. the Rubicon Project, Inc. (NYSE:RUBI) has declined 66.61% since May 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 78.16% the S&P500.
Green Square Capital Llc increased its stake in Amgen Inc (AMGN) by 17.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Green Square Capital Llc bought 7,231 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.99% with the market. The hedge fund held 47,457 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.25M, up from 40,226 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Green Square Capital Llc who had been investing in Amgen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $117.42 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.94% or $1.65 during the last trading session, reaching $176.3. About 2.99 million shares traded. Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN) has risen 3.78% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.77% the S&P500.
